2115440227561193488.en_summary: @danielnewmanUV (reposted by @StockSavvyShay) says the $MSFT numbers to watch are Cloud (AI) growth, followed closely by the capex guide. He expects an Azure beat, capex ticking up slightly and a big year over year jump in backlog, adding that Microsoft has the best balance sheet of the buildout, built on cash flow. A video thumbnail is attached.
2115440227561193488.zh_summary: @danielnewmanUV（由 @StockSavvyShay 轉發）表示，$MSFT 最需要關注的是雲端（AI）增長，其次是資本開支指引。他預期 Azure 業績超出預期，資本開支略為上調，訂單積壓按年大幅增加，並認為微軟在這輪建設中擁有最好的資產負債表，依靠現金流支撐。附上影片縮圖。
